title: Instituto Vita Alere de Prevenção e Posvenção do Suicídio
description:
Instituto Vita Alere de Prevenção e Posvenção do Suicídio

O Instituto Vita Alere tem por visão uma sociedade mais aberta e atenta à saúde mental dos indivíduos, organizações e da própria sociedade, onde a promoção da saúde mental seja um objetivo contínuo, reduzindo preconceitos, criando consciência pública, falando abertamente, valorizando a vida, promovendo formas mais saudáveis de se relacionar e enfrentar os sofrimentos existenciais, facilitando a recuperação e tratamento.Pioneiro no Brasil em sua área, foi fundado em 2013 com a missão de promover a saúde mental do indivíduo, organizações, instituições e sociedade, com o foco na promoção de saúde mental, prevenção e posvenção do suicídio e autolesão, sendo referência na área através do desenvolvimento de projetos, tratamento especializado, pesquisa e atividades de educação, suporte e apoio, com inovação, dedicação, respeito e cuidado.Vita vem do latim, significa VIDA e Alere CUIDAR/NUTRIR, portanto trabalhamos para Cuidar e Nutrir a Vida das pessoas. Acreditamos que o suicídio pode ser prevenido e o luto deve ser acolhido.

Algumas das nossas atividades são:

  • Capacitar profissionais da saúde e educação para manejo em crise suicida e autolesão, criando multiplicadores em diversos setores.
  • Treinar profissionais da mídia e comunicação para lidarem de uma maneira cuidadosa e responsável sobre o tema.
  • Desenvolver projetos customizados em escolas, universidades, empresas e hospitais.
  • Minimizar o sofrimento das pessoas e oferecer suporte em situações de autolesão, comportamento suicida e luto por suicídio.
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar métodos de promoção de saúde mental, valorização da vida e prevenção do suicídio, estando conectado com as pesquisas e estudos mais atuais do tema.

Somos o único Instituto Brasileiro associado ao IASP – International Association for Suicide Prevention e que presta serviços dessa natureza em São Paulo. Nossa equipe é formada por psicólogos e profissionais da área da saúde e educação, especialistas, mestres e doutores com destaque na área.

Especializações: prevencao do suicidio, luto por suicidio, suicidologia, psicologia, saúde mental, automutilação, posvenção, pesquisa, programas, palestras, cursos, treinamentos, atendimento, campanhas, educação sócio emocional, crise, orientação familiar e supervisão.

Funcionários da Instituto Vita Alere de Prevenção e Posvenção do Suicídio

E aí? É só tristeza passageira… ou será que você está com depressão? Nem sempre é fácil diferenciar, mas reconhecer os sinais faz toda a diferença. Neste carrossel, você vai aprender a diferenciar esses dois estados e entender por que toda dor emocional deve sim ser levada a sério. Compartilhe com quem também precisa dessa informação. E lembre-se: existe ajuda profissional disponível. #InstitutoVitaAlere #PrevençãoDoSuicídio #Depressão #Tristeza #SaúdeMental

Cuidar da saúde mental é mais do que acolher: é saber para onde direcionar quem precisa de apoio. O Mapa Saúde Mental mostra caminhos reais para apoio em escolas, empresas e comunidade. No carrossel, você encontra canais essenciais de ajuda como CVV, CAPS e o Instituto Vita Alere, todos localizáveis com facilidade dentro do mapa. Isso faz total diferença nos momentos de urgência. Acesse e compartilhe este post com sua rede. #InstitutoVitaAlere #SetembroAmarelo #PrevençãoDoSuicídio #SaúdeMental #MapaSaúdeMental #CVV

Falar sobre suicídio exige boa vontade? Sim. Mas não só isso. Especialmente em espaços de trabalho e educação, é preciso preparo técnico, sensibilidade ética e compromisso com a continuidade. Uma comunicação mal conduzida pode reforçar estigmas, provocar silenciamentos ou, de tão superficial, simplesmente não gerar impacto algum. Pensando nisso, o Instituto Vita Alere reúne algumas boas práticas que fazem toda a diferença:

  • Capacitar e incentivar lideranças, gestores e educadores a buscar conhecimento de qualidade e desenvolver habilidades para acolher conversas difíceis.
  • Estruturar canais reais de escuta e suporte, que estejam disponíveis o ano todo, não apenas em setembro.
  • Utilizar dados confiáveis e referências científicas. Evitar o sensacionalismo e as frases de impacto que não levam a reflexão nem à ação.
  • Garantir que toda comunicação sobre saúde mental esteja inserida em uma política institucional mais ampla, com objetivos claros, recursos adequados e avaliação de impacto.

No Instituto Vita Alere, trabalhamos para que empresas e instituições construam ambientes mais seguros, responsáveis e atentos à saúde mental de suas equipes.

Setembro Amarelo é uma oportunidade importantíssima de conscientização e mobilização social. Mas para que ele faça a diferença de verdade, campanhas precisam ser cuidadosas, seguras e responsáveis. E não apenas no discurso, viu? Aqui está um checklist essencial para instituições que querem se posicionar de forma ética e efetiva:

  1. Ir além de apenas ações simbólicas - Iluminar prédios ou postar frases prontas só faz sentido se acompanhado de informação qualificada e acesso a recursos de apoio.
  2. Garantir continuidade na prevenção - A empresa precisa promover planos de capacitação permanente, grupos de apoio ou protocolos institucionais.
  3. Caminhos de suporte claros - Os canais de suporte e encaminhamento para casos identificados devem ser bem definidos.
  4. Avaliar o impacto real - Medir mudanças na percepção, busca por ajuda e fortalecimento de redes de apoio, e não apenas curtidas ou presença.
  5. Formar pessoas para dar suporte - Priorizar escuta ativa e primeiros socorros emocionais, em vez de eventos pontuais e sem continuidade.
  6. Planejar ações com clareza e intenção - Definir objetivos específicos, públicos alvo, linguagem acessível e evitar ações superficiais.
  7. Garantir a presença de especialistas - Envolver profissionais capacitados e experientes no tema.
  8. Sempre questionar as intenções - você está buscando marketing institucional ou transformação social?

No Instituto Vita Alere, apoiamos empresas e instituições a criarem ambientes emocionalmente seguros e preparados para lidar com a prevenção do suicídio de forma contínua. Acesse nosso site (vitaalere.com.br) e conheça os cursos e materiais de orientação que preparamos para transformar sua campanha em um compromisso real. #SetembroAmarelo #SaúdeMental #InstitutoVitaAlere #Prevenção

1º de setembro. O país começa a ficar amarelo. Hoje começa o Setembro Amarelo. E, como acontece todos os anos, vemos campanhas surgindo de todos os lados. Escolas, empresas, redes sociais, marcas. Nas próximas semanas, muita gente vai falar de saúde mental, de suicídio, de escuta, de empatia. Isso pode ser bom. Mas também pode ser superficial, confuso, até perigoso. No Vita Alere, nós trabalhamos com esse tema o ano inteiro. Acolhemos famílias em luto. Formamos profissionais. Desenvolvemos guias, pesquisas, encontros, redes. E todos os anos, quando setembro começa, sentimos uma mistura de coisas. É importante ver o tema ganhar visibilidade. Mas é preciso cuidado com o que se diz, com o que se promete, com a forma como se expõe o sofrimento alheio. Nem tudo que brilha é cuidado. Nem toda frase de impacto é prevenção. Setembro não é palco. É espaço de escuta, de compromisso, de continuidade. Falar sobre suicídio exige preparo, ética e responsabilidade. Exige reconhecer que não estamos falando de números, mas de histórias interrompidas, de famílias em pedaços, de silêncios que doem. E que a prevenção verdadeira não cabe em uma ação pontual, nem em uma publicação com hashtag. Setembro pode ser um convite. Mas não pode ser uma fachada. Se você trabalha com esse tema, pense no impacto do que compartilha. Se você vive com dor, não precisa se sentir obrigado a falar só porque é setembro. E se você quer ajudar, comece escutando. Pergunte antes de propor. Ouça antes de divulgar. Reconheça seus limites. Seguimos por aqui, atentos. Com acolhimento, com técnica, com presença. E com a coragem de lembrar que saúde mental não se resolve com cor de campanha, mas com trabalho sério, coletivo e contínuo. Estamos juntos, não só em setembro. #SaudeMental #PrevencaoDoSuicidio #SetembroAmarelo #VitaAlere

Acolher famílias de adolescentes em sofrimento exige preparo, critério e ferramentas seguras.A autolesão na adolescência é um fenômeno cada vez mais presente nos contextos clínicos, escolares e comunitários, e raramente afeta apenas o jovem. Famílias inteiras acabam envolvidas nessa dor, muitas vezes entorpecidas por não saberem como intervir, acolher e fazer as lesões pararem.Pensando nisso, o Instituto Vita Alere oferece o curso Manejo da Família no Comportamento Autolesivo em Adolescentes, com a Prof. Dra. Bruna Mattos Machado. Uma formação essencial para quem atua com saúde mental e deseja se capacitar para orientar famílias de forma ética, técnica e sensível.O que você vai aprender:

Cuidar da saúde mental no trabalho é muito mais do que uma prática possível: é dever de toda empresa que leva a sério a si mesma e as equipes que, todos os dias, a mantêm de pé. Para se ter uma ideia da dimensão dessa necessidade, é só conferir as pesquisas recentes sobre o assunto. Conforme dados do Ministério da Previdência Social divulgados pela Revista Veja, grande parte dos afastamentos em 2024 foi em razão de transtornos de ansiedade (141.414), seguidos por episódios depressivos (113.604) e por transtorno depressivo recorrente (52.627). Somente os afastamentos por ansiedade aumentaram mais de 400% na última década. E os casos de depressão quase dobraram. Ainda assim, quando abordamos esse tema, ele muitas vezes chega aos ouvidos como se fosse um assunto delicado a ponto de parecer intocável. Será que ainda precisamos de tanto receio em pleno 2025? Ao contrário do que se imagina, implementar medidas de cuidado emocional no ambiente corporativo não exige grandes investimentos, mas sim pequenas mudanças com alto impacto: ️ Incentivar pausas reais (sem culpa) ️ Treinar lideranças para escuta ativa ️ Normalizar conversas sobre saúde mental, sem tabu ou julgamento ️ Reavaliar aspectos da cultura organizacional que reforçam o silêncio ️ Criar espaços seguros para pedir ajuda sem medo de retaliação Cuidar da saúde mental no ambiente corporativo não é “mimar” equipes. É preservar o recurso mais valioso que uma empresa pode ter: pessoas inteiras, conectadas e capazes de sustentar resultados sem adoecer no processo.E aqui vai o ponto crucial: saúde mental não se resolve com uma ação no Setembro Amarelo e uma palestra por ano. title: Principal Consultant – SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment
description:
Overview

Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM.
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform.
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization.
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform.
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats.
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation.
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement.
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise.
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD/MTTR.
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO.
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations.
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments.
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows.
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence.
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules.
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus.
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex).
  • Relevant bachelor’s degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel

Additional Information

Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations at paloaltonetworks dot com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: 3D Storyboarder/Layout Artist - Atrium
description:
Hello, talented creatives!

Atrium is Telos Media’s newest YouTube channel, from exploring inside Hitler's final hours to living in the horrifying conditions of Auschwitz. We take viewers to places that are now only accessible through animation and storytelling.

We’ve already had strong momentum, and now, we’re looking for a visionary Part-time 3D Camera Operator to help elevate our next videos.

This role is for someone who lives and breathes visual storytelling. You’ll work hand-in-hand with the Channel Director to map out the visual blueprint for each video—turning scripts into clear, engaging animatics that animators can then bring to life. Done right, your work sets the tone, style, and pacing of the visuals for each upload.

The goal is to take a 3D model we've created, like the inside of a submarine, and bring it to life using static characters and voice-over, all coming together into one final video. We\'re not looking to create test animatics or rough drafts. The aim is to go straight to producing the final version.

If you love storytelling and the process of visually bringing stories to life, then this is your chance to help build a premium content brand from the very beginning. Let’s make something incredible!

Responsibilities

  • Dig into scripts and understand the tone, message, and visual vibe
  • Create animatics that show camera movement, pacing, and animator notes
  • Collaborate with animators to make the vision come to life
  • Suggest visual solutions when something’s not clicking
  • Keep files and assets organized for smooth team access
  • Review final videos, gather feedback, and improve for next time

Must Haves

  • Several years of animation industry experience — YouTube, TV, or film
  • Knows Blender well enough to create the animatics inside it
  • Can adjust visual style depending on the script
  • Has a sharp eye for camera angles, timing, and transitions
  • Knows how to make microscopic or abstract concepts cinematic
  • Can create animatics that feel — emotionally powerful moments that land
  • Brings ideas to the table, not just drawings
  • Is constantly studying great visuals — from movies to sci-fi to docs
  • Is proactive, fast to respond, and excited to grow with us

Good to Haves

  • Can manage animation timelines and teams (as we scale)
  • Understand YouTube audience retention and how visuals play a part
  • Have a strong network of creatives in the space
  • Know how visuals can tap into emotion and psychology
  • Happy to jump in and help across the production process

Key Obsessions (What are you obsessed with?)

  • Obsessed with Visual Storytelling: Always thinking about how to tell a story visually — framing, pacing, movement, and how every shot contributes to the narrative.
  • Obsessed with Viewer Engagement: Constantly asking: “Will this keep the viewer watching?” They look at retention graphs, know how to build hooks, and design moments that emotionally land.
  • Obsessed with Efficiency: Loves building systems that speed things up. They design animatics that are clear, production-ready, and save the animators hours of guesswork.
  • Obsessed with Detail, Without Getting Slowed Down: They notice when a transition doesn’t feel right or a shot lacks emotional punch — but they also know how to move fast and not get stuck.
  • Obsessed with Growth & New Styles: Always exploring fresh visual techniques, studying references from all kinds of media, and pushing the style to evolve beyond the “usual.

  • Exceptional fluency in English across reading, writing, and verbal communication
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in digital marketing or a similar agency environment (preferred)

  • Minimum 2 years of project management experience using PM tools (e.g., ClickUp, Asana—not ticketing platforms)
  • Leadership experience in managing teams or cross-functional projects (preferred)
  • Familiarity with copywriting and marketing funnels (preferred)
  • Strong technical aptitude; comfortable working with automation platforms and digital tools
  • Proven ability to identify inefficiencies and implement long-term, scalable solutions
  • Skilled in breaking down complex projects into clear, actionable steps
  • Capable of making sound decisions independently and managing multiple priorities

Additional requirements

  • Reliable internet connection

  • Operates with a sense of urgency and accountability
  • Comfortable being direct and assertive, especially around deadlines
  • Professional and composed in fast-paced environments
  • Solution-oriented with a positive, can-do attitude
  • Takes ownership and avoids excuses
  • Motivated by impact and loves getting things done

This position is NOT for someone who

  • Struggles with follow-through or self-management
  • Has to be pushed to do their job
  • Prefers a slow-paced work environment
  • Lacks a sense of urgency
  • Thinks “good enough is good enough”

GoHighLevel, Notion, Google Workspace, Printify

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Aqui, você terá o desafio de transformar dados em insights, impactando diretamente a tomada de decisões e a otimização de processos em toda a organização.

title: [Martech] Product Designer II
description:
Como é ser uma pessoa Product Designer:

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Nossa missão é servir Canais Digitais, Marketing e Growth com tecnologia para alavancar o crescimento e a eficiência do funil de vendas. Somos um time de tecnologia responsável pelos sites das marcas do grupo (Stone, Ton e Pagar.me) — cuidando de CMS, infraestrutura e evolução contínua — e pelas ferramentas que suportam marketing e vendas, como Salesforce e Marketcloud. Trabalhamos para criar experiências digitais escaláveis, integradas e alinhadas à estratégia do negócio.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Product Designer, com foco em criação de interfaces e experiências digitais para plataformas web.
  • Capacidade de conduzir todo o processo de design, desde a pesquisa com usuários até a entrega de wireframes, protótipos e especificações.
  • Conhecimento em design systems e ferramentas como Figma, FigJam, entre outras.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa, comunicando-se com as equipes de desenvolvimento, produto e marketing para garantir que as soluções propostas atendam às necessidades do usuário e aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e entrega interativa.
  • Habilidade para conduzir testes de usabilidade e análises de comportamento de usuários, garantindo que os designs sejam orientados por dados e feedback real.
  • Foco constante na experiência do usuário, sempre buscando simplificar e otimizar o design.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs ou no mercado financeiro.
  • Habilidade em design de interfaces para sistemas complexos e de grande escala.
  • Experiência com metodologias como Design Thinking e Lean UX.
  • Habilidade de comunicação para apresentar e defender as escolhas de design de forma clara e impactante.
  • Desejo de se atualizar constantemente sobre novas tendências e práticas no design de produtos.

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Overview

APTIM's Energy Transition is seeking an experienced Sr. Account Manager . This position is based in Minnesota and serves as a primary conduit to the market providing education and collaboration to stakeholders on behalf of the HOMES/HEAR program. APTIM's role is to develop and manage Home Energy Rebates created through the Inflation Reduction Act including the Home Efficiency Rebate Program (HOMES) and the Home Electrification and Appliance Rebate Program (HEAR). The Sr. Account Manager will be responsible for networking with customers and stakeholders to drive program performance and goal attainment. Residential program knowledge and technical expertise in energy efficiency and electrification is required. This role will report to the Program Manager.

APTIM's Energy Transition team is a recognized leader in the marketplace. Our technical experts deliver highly innovative projects and complex client solutions providing the full breadth of energy solutions including energy management, carbon management, smart energy infrastructure, distributed energy resources (DER), and carbon-free mobility solutions. Our consultants proactively collaborate with clients to define and implement strategies and campaigns around key business drivers, with the primary focus of finding and delivering high-impact projects exceeding expectations and meeting the unique needs for our clients.

The successful candidate will immediately assume an active role supporting the planning and operational activities for the programs. The Sr. Account Manager is responsible for utilizing existing community partners and building a network of stakeholders and customers targeting energy efficiency projects that align with the HOMES/HEAR program. The Sr. Account Manager will be expected to engage with organizations proactively to understand their unique goals and challenges and communicate how the HOMES/HEAR programs can support those goals and challenges. This position will be a critical member of the team by informing overarching strategic direction and driving new initiatives and energy savings.

This position is based in Minnesota and will have frequent day travel within specific territories. There is the opportunity for travel outside of the area, sporadically, for conferences, events, and continuing education. The Sr. Account Manager must be a critical thinker, able to manage multiple tasks, have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and be able to maintain positive relationships with colleagues, stakeholders, and partners. The role requires a person who is accountable, process driven, detail-oriented, and pragmatic. Individuals in this role will be expected to embrace a collaborative approach, take ownership of their workspace, and find solutions to challenges as they arise and be highly flexible to adjust to program needs. In this role, you will be working with others who are passionate about clean energy, energy efficiency, and making a positive impact on the industry.

Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Work as part of an energy efficiency and electrification team ensuring the administration, implementation, and verification of federally funded energy efficiency projects are successfully executed.
  • Develop reporting that aligns with DOE requirements and provides operations leadership insights to improve operations.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage existing or potential organizations to produce qualified leads, layer services/rebates and/or improve the customer experience, driving project participation.
  • Connect regularly with organizations via phone, email, virtual platforms, and face-to-face discussions to ensure they are current on HOMES/HEAR offerings and efforts, and to gain the organizations perspective on issues relating to the programs.
  • Lead and project manage initiatives that drive toward improved customer experience and participation in programs.
  • Develop and lead presentations promoting HOMES/HEAR programs at various conferences, community events, or professional organizations.
  • Respond to direct inquiries and requests made by customers, organizations, and stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Deliver supporting information, collateral, and contacts to partners to support deepened customer engagement.
  • Be attuned to broad regulator, policy, and economic concerns impacting programs and bring these perspectives to program leadership.
  • Perform field QAQC as needed within assigned territory.
  • Frequent day travel and occasional overnight (depending on conferences, training or other opportunities).
  • All other duties as assigned.
  • Ensuring compliance with all APTIM quality and safety policies as well as all OSHA regulations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of industry experience required.
  • Knowledge of energy efficiency and electrification programs.
  • Experience working with any of the following stakeholders: businesses, contractors, utilities, CBOs, community leaders, retailers, program implementers, manufacturers or distributors of energy-efficient equipment or services.
  • Strong service orientation with the ability to work across multiple departments and units within an organization, external clients, and multiple stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent time management, project management, and follow-through; creative problem solver with strong analytical abilities.
  • Ability to absorb information from multiple parties and formulate necessary communications or decisions quickly.
  • Conceptual understanding of energy efficiency, electrification, renewable energy, and the types of equipment, technologies, and building practices relevant to residential customers.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Experience in the use of typical productivity software tools.
  • Strong quantitative and analytic capabilities to interpret data and solve practical problems.
  • Exceptional relationship management skills.
  • Ability to travel within Minnesota regularly and occasionally out-of-state.
  • Must be a self-starter, organized and have an ability to manage competing priorities with established deadlines.
  • Commitment to fostering a collaborative work environment within the team and broader organization.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office software -- Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint.

Desired/Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience working with a wide variety of stakeholders, such as state, local and federal governments, for-profit and non-profit organizations, utilities, multifamily properties and others.
  • CEM, BPI, QCI, PMP, or similar certification.
  • 3+ years' experience in the energy efficiency industry.

About APTIM

APTIM is committed to accelerating the transition toward a clean and efficient energy economy, building a sustainable future for our communities and natural world, and creating a more inclusive and equitable environment that celebrates the diversity of our communities. We specialize in environmental, resilience, and sustainability and energy solutions, as well as technical and data solutions, program management, and critical infrastructure. For every challenge our clients face, there is an opportunity for APTIM to innovate a fit-for-purpose solution that will raise your organization or community to a new standard of excellence.

What you can expect from APTIM:

  • Work that is worthy of your time and talent
  • Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
  • Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
  • A voice in making our company better
  • Investment into your personal and professional development

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $90K-$140K. Compensation depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.

Employee Benefits

Aptim Environmental & Infrastructure, LLC is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well-being of our employees and their families. Benefits Marketplace information is available internally.

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and 10+ carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location.
  • Life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • 401(k) APTIM offers three 401k plans through the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (PEP). The specific plan you are eligible for depends on the business unit you are in. The details of the largest plan are found here.

title: Product Designer
description:
Who We Are

We are a leader in fraud prevention and AML compliance. Our platform uses device intelligence, behavior biometrics, machine learning, and AI to stop fraud before it happens. Today, over 300 banks, retailers, and fintechs worldwide use Sardine to stop identity fraud, payment fraud, account takeovers, and social engineering scams. We have raised $145M from world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Activant, Visa, Experian, FIS, and Google Ventures.

Our Culture

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, and Toronto. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere
  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn\'t have to miss your family dinner, your kid\'s school play, friends get-together, or doctor\'s appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location: Remote - Brazil

To be considered for this position, you must reside in one of the following cities:

  • São Paulo: São Paulo, Campinas, São José dos Campos
  • Rio de Janeiro: Rio de Janeiro
  • Minas Gerais: Belo Horizonte
  • Paraná: Curitiba
  • Santa Catarina: Florianópolis

About The Role

We\'re a growing company looking for a Product Designer to join our team and help us design a user-centric SaaS dashboard to prevent fraud.

This isn\'t just about pixels; it\'s about problem-solving. You\'ll work closely with other designers, product managers, and engineers to understand complex challenges and create intuitive and comprehensive experiences for our users. We have a complex product; you will need to make it easy.

As a fast-growing start-up, you will need to independently explore the context, talk to different stakeholders, understand the problem end-to-end, and propose solutions that make sense with our product.

Requests usually come with just the tip of the iceberg. You will need to get into the bushes. This role is not for a Product Designer that expects a complete brief, a list of detailed tasks, and endless calls. We move fast. You need to be fast. And good.

What You\'ll Do

  • Proactively drive the entire design process, from independently identifying user problems and exploring solutions through research and validation, to final implementation and hand-off.
  • Go beyond the \"happy path\" by designing for all user flows, edge cases, and UI states to ensure a smooth hand-off to engineering.
  • We are remote, you need to show visibility, communicate status, and progress reports with your team. Comment, annotate, and tag teammates in all your files. Work closely with product managers and engineers.

What You\'ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience (or strong portfolio) designing UI and UX for dashboards and SaaS products.
  • Master Figma, with expertise in Auto Layout, Components, Variants, and Prototypes
  • Master Design Systems and their application to create and scale a consistent dashboard experience
  • User-centered design principles with a strong understanding of data visualization best practices
  • Experience communicating with leadership. You will communicate ideas and ping pong requirements with the CEO, CTO, and CPO levels.
  • Be aware of the future state of design. AI is changing the game. We are already exploring new design workflows.
  • Startup / Small Company / Founder Experience

Bonus Points

  • Experience working in globally distributed teams
  • If you\'ve worked in Fraud, AML, Compliance, Payments, Fintech, Banking, that\'s a plus
  • Played around with Figma Make, Gemini, Loveable, v0, or similar? Sweet!
  • A little front-end code familiarity will make your job easier

Compensation

Base pay range of R$265,000- R$370,000 BRL + Series C equity with tremendous upside potential + Attractive benefits

The compensation offered for this role will depend on various factors, including the candidate\'s location, qualifications, work history, and interview performance, and may differ from the stated range.

Benefits We Offer

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested
  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture
  • Flexible paid time off, Year-end break, Self care days off
  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific
  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

title: Placement Matching Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
About Virtual Internships

We’re on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting our VI-P Guide , which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

IWG is the world’s leading flexible workspace provider – with the world’s most ambitious growth programme to open 30,000+ new centres over the next decade to complement our international network of 4,000+ tech-enabled, sustainable and inspiring flexible work centres. You’ll need to be passionate about working in a high-growth sector and ready to play a leading role in disrupting the commercial real-estate industry. You’ll excel at growing your network rapidly and taking our proposition to them. And you’ll thrive on initiating and closing multiple high-value deals at pace driven by your tenacity and expertise.

Most importantly though, you’ll have the right, can-do mindset: passion, curiosity, pride, drive and ownership. We’ll look after the rest.

  • Actively manage your pipeline of opportunities to drive each opportunity from initial contact, through detailed commercial negotiations, all the way to a signed commercial agreement.

Carbon Neutral Workplaces

IWG’s purpose is to help everyone have a great day at work, while protecting people and the planet. We are proud to supply all our customers with carbon-neutral workplaces, and have a strong climate action plan in place to help us achieve our objective of Net Zero emissions by 2040.

Leading Employer Award

IWG is proud to be the recipient of a Leading Employer Award in 2022, 2023 and 2024. Awarded exclusively to the top 1% of employers, the accolade is testament to our diverse global workforce and the role everyone plays in bringing our purpose, culture and values to life, every single day.

Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. Proactively contribute ideas and optimizations that drive business goals, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Join WKND as a Senior Paid Social Acquisition Specialist and become a pivotal force behind high-performing, AI-enhanced campaigns for top DTC brands. About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.

description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atuando nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, a instituição promove políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM amplia suas ações com projetos em andamento na área de Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Disponibilizamos um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para ser direcionado às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

  • Formação de acordo com a área de interesse;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área;
  • Salário + Benefícios;
  • Escala e horário de trabalho a serem definidos;
  • Locais de trabalho: Zona Norte, Oeste e Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em modalidades contratuais diferentes, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM é uma associação reconhecida por sua atuação social e compromisso com a saúde pública, promovendo ações integradas com a gestão pública, visando garantir acesso universal à saúde, com equipes multiprofissionais de alta qualificação, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 na cidade de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e qualidade de vida da população, pautado na integralidade e equidade.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando periodicamente anúncios de recrutamento nos principais jornais das regiões de atuação.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência na gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade a toda a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Associate Investigator
description:
Chainalysis Investigators are world-class problem solvers adept at covert analysis and conducting complex investigations. Our team combines technical knowledge with tenacity and intuition. We help our customers with thorny and complex investigations and along the way, make the world a safer place.

As an Investigator, you are equally adept at proactively conducting research, employing data analysis, writing, and presenting your investigative findings to team members and customers alike. You are comfortable evangelizing the Chainalysis mission of bringing trust to blockchains, and are an expert at using our tools and data to develop insights on illicit activity trends in crypto and its impact on our customers. Collaborating with team members and across Chainalysis, you will help support the most complex financial crime investigations to meet and exceed customer requirements.

In the LATAM and the Caribbean region, you will have an unique opportunity to impact how cryptocurrency crime is investigated. You will work hand in hand with public and private sector customers in order to build capacity and enable them in the exciting and challenging world of blockchain analysis and cryptocurrency investigations.

  • In this role, you'll:

    • Collaborate with team members and across Chainalysis to support complex cryptocurrency investigations

    • Provide investigative/analytic support for extremely complex, technical, and highly sensitive investigations and initiatives pertaining to financial crimes, including cryptocurrencies

    • Conduct research and data analysis, author reports of your investigative findings, and present those findings to team members and customers

    • Review the adequacy and completeness of investigations and the data collection methods to determine the authenticity, veracity, and pertinence of that data resulting in more thorough investigations or analytic assessments.

    • Prepare in-depth summaries of data from extensive research and analysis to set forth recommendations for investigations, lead follow up, and potential risks that could hamper an investigation

    • Evangelize the Chainalysis mission of bringing trust to blockchains, becoming an expert at using our tools and data to develop insights on illicit activity trends in crypto and its impact on our customers.

    • Develop, update and present workshops and training materials in the region's languages: English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese

    We're looking for candidates who have:

    • A degree in cybersecurity, cyber crime, intelligence, criminal justice, forensic accounting, data analytics, or a similar

    • Previous work experience conducting complex financial crime investigations for federal government, intelligence analysis or law enforcement investigations, financial services or cryptocurrency companies, or equivalent forensic experience related to dark web, counter-terrorism, or technical analysis highly desired

    • Experience conducting open-source research utilizing public and private databases highly desired

    • Interest in and/or passion for blockchain/cryptocurrency technology

    • Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish and English

    • Preferably based out of Brazil.

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here . We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Analista Governança e Controle Pleno – Globo – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Overview

Analista Governança e Controle Pleno – Globo – Rio de Janeiro

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

O Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) da Globo tem a missão de viabilizar e agregar valor às operações da empresa. Com uma grande diversidade de escopos e de colaboradores (são mais de 1.700), é natural que tenha um desafio de governança.

Com um robusto orçamento de investimentos e despesas para prestar serviços internos e desenvolver projetos de conservação e modernização do parque de infraestrutura, a diretoria sensibiliza os direcionadores estratégicos da Globo de geração de valor econômico-financeiro e de compromissos ESG.

Neste contexto, torna-se essencial um modelo de gestão robusto, com métricas, rotinas, padrões, reportes e captação do valor gerado pela aplicação de tantos recursos e processos.

O VMO beneficia o CSC construindo uma visão estratégica da diretoria e garantindo uma governança de projetos madura, com metodologia, entregas transparentes, de qualidade e alinhadas com a Globo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

Como atendimento em Projetos

  • Acompanha e reporta o desenvolvimento dos projetos de áreas clientes, verificando o cumprimento de cronogramas, orçamento, escopo e critérios de qualidade/valor.
  • Elabora, define e dissemina metodologias e ferramentas que apoiem o gerenciamento de projetos nas áreas e projetos estratégicos da diretoria, sempre alinhado com as últimas tendências.
  • Apoia a interface com outras áreas envolvidas nos projetos.
  • Analisa os indicadores de projetos, reportando os resultados na área.
  • Atua como gestor de projetos adHOC, estruturando um plano, antecipando riscos, formatando, acompanhando e reportando o desenvolvimento dos trabalhos e gerindo os impactos de forma a preservar os produtos combinados.

No ciclo orçamentário de projetos

  • Levant a e elabora cenários para defesa do ciclo com contexto interno, externo e desafios.
  • Conduz e consolida defesa dos projetos dos departamentos para o diretor executivo.
  • Presta consultoria e suporte técnico às áreas no período de ciclo orçamentário, utilizando como base as melhores práticas e uso de ferramentas.
  • Consolida o orçamento de projetos dos departamentos e elabora apresentação para defesa do planejamento do CSC para os próximos anos.

No ciclo de gestão de OKRs

  • Conduz e reporta o andamento dos OKRs estratégicos do CSC e táticos de Governança e Controle.
  • Conduz o processo de definição, acompanhamento e revisão de OKRs, alinhados à estratégia da organização.
  • Facilita workshops e reuniões de alinhamento com lideranças e pontos focais.

No apoio à medição e melhoria de processos e tarefas

  • Analisa gaps, tendências e desvios, propondo e/ou cobrando planos de ação para corrections de rumo.
  • Analisa, consolida, valida e divulga, periodicamente, indicadores e resultados por meio relatórios gerenciais.
  • Identifica oportunidades de otimização operacional nas áreas, a fim de eliminar desperdícios.

No apoio à gestão

  • Elabora conteúdos gerenciais, com visão executiva que facilitem a análise de informações para acompanhamento de resultados e tomada de decisão.
  • Realiza ações de comunicação e engajamento, acerca de assuntos que são transversais na área, a fim de garantir abrangência, uniformidade e alinhamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou correlatas.
  • Habilidade no pacote Microsoft 365, com destaque ao Excel (intermediário/avançado);
  • Produção de relatórios em Power BI (intermediário);
  • Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de projetos (métodos tradicionais ou ágeis) e OKR;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara e eficaz com diferentes níveis hierárquicos;
  • Visão analítica, ser interessado, proativo, organizado e com energia para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas ao mesmo tempo.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Gestão e melhoria contínua de processos (PDCA, DMAIC, ferramenta Bizagi);
  • Automação de processos. Ex: VBA no Excel, Power Automate no Microsoft 365;
  • Certificações como PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma ou similares;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com estrutura de VMO ou PMO;
  • Usuário de ferramenta de controle de projetos (PPM). Ex: ERP Oracle, Jira, Clarity PPM, Primavera;
  • Programação no Power BI;
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio.

Overview

About the Role

We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator to join Tinder’s LATAM Marketing team in Brazil. This is a hands-on and supportive role, perfect for someone early in their career who’s eager to learn, grow, and make an impact. You’ll help the team bring Tinder to life through marketing campaigns, activations, and cultural moments that connect with young people in authentic ways.

This role is a great opportunity to gain experience across different areas of marketing, from social to experiential, while being part of a creative and fast-moving team. As you grow in the position, you’ll have the chance to take on more ownership of projects and initiatives.

Our Values

  • One Team, One Dream We work hand-in-hand, building Tinder for our members. We succeed together when we work collaboratively across functions, teams, and time zones, and think outside the box to achieve our company vision and mission.
  • Own It We take accountability and strive to make a positive impact in all aspects of our business, through ownership, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.
  • Never Stop Learning We cultivate a culture where it’s safe to take risks. We seek out input, share honest feedback, celebrate our wins, and learn from our mistakes in order to continue improving.
  • Spark Solutions We’re problem solvers, focusing on how to best move forward when faced with obstacles. We don’t dwell on the past or on the issues at hand, but instead look at how to stay agile and overcome hurdles to achieve our goals.
  • Embrace Our Differences We are intentional about building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members. By leveraging different perspectives and other ways of thinking, we build better experiences for our members and our team.

What You’ll Do

  • Support the execution of integrated marketing campaigns (social, digital, experiential, partnerships)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (social, PR, comms, growth, product marketing) to keep projects moving
  • Help track and report on campaign performance
  • Assist with project management, timelines, budgets, and vendor coordination including working with partners in Finance and Legal
  • Stay close to cultural trends, social platforms, and Gen Z behaviors to inspire new ideas
  • Support the team with day-to-day marketing operations and admin tasks

What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in marketing, advertising, or communications (agency or brand side)
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English
  • Strong connection with social media platforms, digital culture, and emerging trends
  • Proactive, curious, and ready to learn in a fast-paced environment

Bonus Points

  • Experience in consumer tech, lifestyle, entertainment, or youth-focused brands.
  • Knowledge of social media and content trends
  • Experience with events, activations, or influencer marketing
  • Spanish is a plus

Why Join Us

At Tinder, we believe in creating meaningful connections, not only for our members but also within our team. As a Marketing Coordinator, you’ll gain hands-on experience across multiple areas of marketing, with opportunities to learn, grow, and take on new responsibilities over time. You’ll be part of a passionate, creative, and collaborative LATAM marketing squad, helping shape how Tinder shows up in Brazilst

Commitment to Inclusion

At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. Tinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we welcome people of all sexes, gender identities, races, ethnicities, disabilities, and other lived experiences. Learn more here:

If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition Partner directly.

We are looking for an Expert Support Engineer who is ready to join us in creating a #CyberFit future and protecting the digital world.

    • Networking - analyzing the traffic with Wireshark, tcpdump, iperf. Troubleshooting network services like DHCP, DNS, VPN, L2TP/IPSEC/Open VPN, HTTP servers. Cisco/Juniper certifications are a plus.
    • Virtualization expertise - managing and troubleshooting various enterprise-grade hypervisors such as VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM, and Virtuozzo.

Who We Are

Acronis is a global cyber protection company that provides natively integrated cybersecurity, data protection, and endpoint management for MSPs, SMBs, enterprise IT departments and home users. Our all-in-one solutions are highly efficient and designed to identify, prevent, detect, respond, remediate, and recover from modern cyberthreats with minimal downtime, ensuring data integrity and business continuity. We offer the most comprehensive security solution on the market for MSPs with our unique ability to meet the needs of diverse and distributed IT environments.

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and more than 1800 employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 20,000 service providers to protect over 750,000 businesses.

Our corporate culture is focused on making a positive impact on the lives of each employee and the communities we serve. Mutual trust, respect and belief that we can contribute to the world everyday are the cornerstones of our team. Each member of our “A-Team” plays an instrumental role in driving the success of our innovative and expanding business. We seek individuals who excel in dynamic, global environments and have a never give up attitude, contributing to our collective growth and impact.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process.

Use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during live interviews may be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process and a full criminal, education and identification background check is required for all new hires.

Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Syneos Health is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. When we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete via review of site source documents and medical records. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and action items to resolution.
  • Understands project scope, budgets, and timelines for own and others’ activities in the clinical team; manages site-level activities/communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals/targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in and may lead global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • May provide direct supervision, training and/or mentorship to more junior level CRAs. Performs training and sign off visits for junior CRA staff, as assigned. May be mentored and assigned lead tasks under supervision of an experienced Clinical Operations Lead (COL) or operational line manager. This could include participation in business development proposals and/or defense meetings.
  • For Real World Late Phase (RWLP), the Sr. CRA II will use the business card title of Sr.Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include: site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs. Chart abstraction activities and data collection. Collaborate and build relationship with Sponsor and other affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. Train junior staff if required. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and HCP associations. Identify operational efficiencies and process improvements. Develop study and country level informed consent forms. Collaborate with RWLP Regulatory team to ensure updated regulatory information is applied and shared. Participate in bid defense meetings. Provide input into Requests for Proposals (RFPs), scope and budgeting. Develop site management strategy. Participate in Case Report Form design and edit check development.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Moderate level of critical thinking skills expected.
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
