Overview

Quorum is the leading provider of AI-powered workflow software for public affairs professionals. Our platform helps over 2,000 organizations—including over half the Fortune 100—track legislation, manage stakeholders, and take strategic action across all levels of government.

AI is now at the heart of our platform—from semantic search and bill analysis to Copilot recommendations and personalized insights. The GenAI Engineering Manager will be a key technical leader in bringing this strategy to life.

About the Role

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead 2 or 3 teams delivering GenAI features across Quorum’s platform. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product, Data, and Design teams to translate business goals into scalable, AI-first solutions.

You’ll be responsible for leading execution and engineering quality across:

  • Agentic AI systems that power multi-step Copilot workflows
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and hybrid search infrastructure
  • LLM-based personalization and summarization for legislative, regulatory, and media content
  • AI evaluation frameworks that track accuracy, latency, and user trust
  • Developer productivity tools that support rapid, reliable AI delivery

While you’ll engage in architecture and hands-on discussions, your focus is team leadership, technical execution, and building repeatable delivery patterns for AI-first development.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with 1–3+ years in technical leadership or management
  • Proven technical project management and stakeholder management skills within an agile environment
  • Experience shipping LLM-based & agentic AI systems in production—e.g., Chatbots, RAG, semantic search, summarization, agentic workflows
  • Technical fluency in Python, AWS, and orchestration libraries such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or OpenAI/Bedrock APIs
  • Familiarity with vector databases and hybrid search tools (e.g., Qdrant, OpenSearch, Pinecone)
  • Experience leading teams through ambiguity, iteration, and tight feedback loops
  • Strong people leadership skills—mentoring ICs, guiding system design, and improving engineering maturity
  • A bias toward action and learning—shipping fast while investing in quality and infrastructure

Why Quorum

  • Lead a team building core GenAI features in a mission-driven company
  • Work across multiple product surfaces—legislative tracking, insights, search, and digests
  • Partner with senior engineers and data scientists on a high-caliber technical team
  • Remote flexibility, strong leadership support, and a clear roadmap for AI growth

We are a fully remote team with engineers based in the U.S., Brazil, and Moldova. You’ll work closely with teammates across time zones and cultures in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

About the Software Development Team

  • We\'re a fast-growing team dedicated to improving our people, processes, and platform. The team is primarily structured into product-oriented squads.
  • We support many different products but internally think of them as one system with a single unified codebase. We aim to build centralized systems that handle complex problems for multiple features and products.
  • We’re focused on doing the important things the right way -- we write solid documentation, test our code well, design for scale, and follow defined software development processes.
  • We follow best-in-class security practices to safeguard our data and application against bad actors. We regularly test and update processes and technology to fight complacency because we know good security is a continuous effort.
  • We curate high-quality datasets essential for effective mapping and tracking of the government and public affairs spaces. Our datasets underpin our promise to give users the information necessary to make smart decisions influencing policy.
  • We set rigorous quality standards and monitor them with a mix of programmatic and manual verifications to ensure users maintain high trust in our systems.
  • We’re very close as a team and invest not only in each others’ skills and careers but also in building real relationships with one another: product development is a team sport, and we believe that it’s better (and more fun) to work on a team of people that you know well and care about.
  • We are a remote-first team with flexible work options: work remotely, or you may choose to come into our office in Belo Horizonte.
  • Standard Brazil holidays plus additional company-wide days off for team members to rest and recharge
  • Free Subscription to the Calm App
  • Free Subscription to LinkedIn Learning to support professional development
  • Invest in Yourself Days - one designated day per quarter is dedicated to your professional development!
  • Monthly Work from Home Stipend
  • Virtual and in-person team events
  • Mental Health stipend
  • In company English classes

title: SysOps - Administrador de sistemas Pleno
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Administrador de Infraestrutura de TI Pleno e Sênior altamente qualificado, responsável por gerenciar, manter e garantir o bom funcionamento dos sistemas de TI, tanto em ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem. O profissional deve ter uma ampla experiência em virtualização com VMware e Microsoft Hyper-V, além de domínio em automação de infraestrutura como código (IaC) usando Ansible e Terraform. Este é um papel 100% Home Office com a responsabilidade de projetar, implementar e suportar infraestruturas complexas em ambientes multicloud e híbridos, garantindo a continuidade dos serviços de TI.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Gerenciamento e Manutenção de Ambientes Virtualizados: Manter e otimizar ambientes VMware (on-premises e cloud) e Hyper-V, garantindo alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança das máquinas virtuais.
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar VLANs, virtual switches e roteamento de tráfego em ambientes virtualizados, além de implementar e monitorar soluções de redes TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN e firewalls.
  • Automação de Infraestrutura (IaC): Automatizar processos de provisionamento e gerenciamento de infraestrutura utilizando Ansible e Terraform, implementando soluções de automação que otimizem o tempo e recursos.
  • Gerenciamento de Multicloud e Nuvem Híbrida: Administração de ambientes multicloud em plataformas como AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, IBM Cloud e Huawei Cloud, além de integração e migração entre nuvens públicas e privadas.
  • Administração de Sistemas Operacionais: Administração avançada de sistemas operacionais Linux (RedHat, SUSE, Debian) e Windows Server, garantindo segurança, disponibilidade e atualização contínua dos servidores.
  • Gerenciamento de Storage e Filesystems: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento (NAS, SAN) e volumes lógicos (LVM), com expertise em administração de sistemas de arquivos e backups eficientes, preferencialmente utilizando a solução VEEAM.
  • Segurança de Infraestrutura: Implementar e gerenciar políticas de segurança em firewalls, controle de acesso e proteção contra ameaças cibernéticas em ambientes on-premises e cloud.
  • Monitoramento e Suporte Proativo: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas, redes e serviços com ferramentas de monitoramento, respondendo de forma proativa a alertas e problemas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Proficiência avançada em Linux (RedHat, SUSE, Debian) e Windows Server , com capacidade de gerenciar e solucionar problemas em ambientes complexos.
  • Virtualização: Domínio avançado de VMware (vSphere, vCenter, ESXi) e Microsoft Hyper-V , incluindo clustering, migração de máquinas virtuais e otimização de performance.
  • Cloud Computing: Experiência comprovada em ambientes multicloud com AWS , Azure , Google Cloud , IBM Cloud e Huawei Cloud , incluindo a migração e gerenciamento de workloads em cloud.
  • Redes e Virtualização de Rede: Conhecimento sólido de redes (TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN) e experiência com virtual switches , roteamento e isolamento de rede em ambientes virtualizados.
  • Automação de Infraestrutura: Habilidade prática em Ansible e Terraform para automação de provisionamento, configuração e gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Gerenciamento de Storage: Experiência em gerenciamento de LVM , sistemas de arquivos e infraestrutura de armazenamento (NAS, SAN), além de administração de backups com VEEAM .
  • Segurança e Firewalls: Implementação de políticas de segurança em firewalls e controle de acesso, proteção de infraestrutura contra ameaças cibernéticas em ambiente híbrido.
  • Diagnóstico e Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de identificar e solucionar problemas complexos de hardware, software, redes e storage.
  • Planejamento e Implementação: Habilidade para planejar e executar atualizações de sistemas, migrações, e implementar novas infraestruturas de TI, além de apoiar o time de vendas com precificação e levantamento de custos utilizando calculadoras de cloud.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações em VMware (VCP), Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, ou Google Cloud.
  • Experiência em containers e Kubernetes para orquestração em ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de monitoramento como Zabbix, Prometheus ou Grafana.

Superior concluído.

Overview

Based in Washington, D.C., Quorum is a fast-growing software company and is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals across the corporate, non-profit, association, and governmental end-markets. Quorum allows users to manage stakeholder engagement, launch grassroots advocacy campaigns, and track legislative activity at all levels of government, including federal, state and local.

Quorum provides mission-critical solutions to public affairs professionals for their work in Congress, all 50 state legislatures, major U.S. cities, the European Union, and 30+ countries around the globe. Quorum serves over 2,000 customers globally including over 50% of the Fortune 100, and has over 350 team members across the globe. The company recently acquired Capitol Canary, a market leader in grassroots advocacy software.

Responsibilities

As a Salesforce Engineer on our team, you will play a critical role in maintaining a suite of managed packages, providing exceptional development and support to our customers. Your responsibilities will include guiding the ongoing development of our Salesforce products as requirements evolve, ensuring that our solutions continue to meet the needs of our clients. By helping clients maximize the value of their investment in our KnowWho to Salesforce product, you will directly contribute to their success and satisfaction.

  • First Week: Learn about the Salesforce team structure and relevant processes.
  • First Month: Develop a comprehensive understanding of our KnowWho Salesforce CRM packages and products.
  • First Six Months - Year: Maintain a suite of Salesforce managed packages. You will oversee the entire lifecycle of package development, from initial design through development, testing, and deployment, ensuring high-quality deliverables at each stage.

About You

  • We’re a close-knit team of innovative, hardworking, and optimistic people who value responsibility, productive discourse, and personal growth
  • We work hard to deliberately develop our team member’s careers. We are voracious learners and will be your mentors, confidantes, and supporters
  • Our team is dedicated to building and growing a remarkable company. Working at Quorum is unique and particularly fulfilling because each team member’s work directly impacts the company’s success.

About the Engineering Team

  • We’re a fast-growing team that is dedicated to improving our people, processes, and platform. The multi-cultural team is composed of a DevOps team, the software engineering team, the Product Management team, the Product Design team, and an Information Security team.
  • We support many different products but internally think of them as one system with a single unified codebase. Our goal is to build centralized systems that handle complex problems for multiple features and products.
  • We’re focused on doing the important things the right way -- we write solid documentation, test our code well, design for scale, and follow defined software development processes.
  • We follow best-in-class security practices to safeguard our data and application against bad actors. We regularly test and update processes and technology to fight complacency, because we know good security is a continuous effort.
  • We curate high-quality datasets that are essential for effective mapping and tracking of the government and public affairs spaces. Our datasets underpin our promise to give users the information necessary to make smart decisions that influence policy.
  • We set rigorous quality standards and monitor them with a mix of programmatic and manual verifications to ensure users maintain a high degree of trust in our systems.
  • We’re very close as a team and invest not only in each others’ skills and careers but also in building real relationships with one another: product development is a team sport and we believe that it’s better (and more fun) to work on a team of people that you know well and care about.
  • We are a remote-first team with flexible work options: work remotely, or you may choose to come into our office in Belo Horizonte.
  • Our team loves to spend time doing fun things outside of the office, which we call Quorum Fun events. Past Quorum Fun events have included apple picking, yoga, and wine tasting

If you’d like to have a big impact at a fast-growing company that is changing the way the advocacy process works, drop us a line. We'd love to talk to you!

This is a general track for first-level engineering management positions at Canonical.
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable, and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. They are trusted engineers who understand the importance of a whole-team effort in creating great products and who enjoy seeing colleagues develop. Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

We are hiring a Mid-level Software Engineer to join our BASE Focus Area (Tagus team) in Brazil. This is a Remote position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. This role is open to candidates in Brazil only.

At the Tagus team, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users, clients, and partners around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models.

We face challenges such as providing flexibility for different commercial conditions across users and contexts, managing clients’ and users’ subscriptions, and supplying data to the ecosystem as the source of truth for these entities.

Technically, our team builds highly scalable solutions with large data volumes and high availability. Given our central role, you’ll have opportunities to influence architecture decisions across our microservices ecosystem and to develop both leadership and technical skills.

  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (Java/Ruby/Go/C/C++/others); Golang is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across countries and cultures.

Quorum allows users to manage stakeholder engagement, launch grassroots advocacy campaigns, and track legislative activity at all levels of government, including federal, state and local.

Quorum provides mission-critical solutions to public affairs professionals for their work in Congress, all 50 state legislatures, major U.S. cities, the European Union, and 30+ countries around the globe. Quorum serves over 2,000 customers globally including over 50% of the Fortune 100, and has over 350 team members across the globe. The company recently acquired Capitol Canary, a market leader in grassroots advocacy software.

The Software Engineering team develops high quality datasets, operates data pipelines, develops data models, and builds services and APIs to support server-side application logic, monitor for and improve performance and integrate with the front-end. The engineer will collaborate with the rest of the engineering and product teams to design and launch new product features.

As a Senior Software Engineer within Quorum\'s development team, you\'ll contribute to the company\'s mission of delivering exceptional software for public affairs professionals. Reporting to an Engineering Manager, you\'ll utilize a full-stack approach, employing tools like Python, Django, PostgreSQL, AWS, and more. The Aluminium team drives Quorum’s AI strategies by designing and implementing advanced solutions that enhance our products and empower users to achieve their goals.   • You are looking to join a dynamic team immediately.

About the Software Development Team

  • We\’re a fast-growing team that is dedicated to improving our people, processes, and platform. The 100+ person team is composed of different functions including software engineering, Product Management, Product Design, QA, Devops/SRE and an Information Security team.
  • We support many different products but internally think of them as one system with a single unified codebase. Our goal is to build centralized systems that handle complex problems for multiple features and products.
  • We\’re focused on doing the important things the right way -- we write solid documentation, test our code well, design for scale, and follow defined software development processes.
  • We follow best-in-class security practices to safeguard our data and application against bad actors. We regularly test and update processes and technology to fight complacency, because we know good security is a continuous effort.

DRUMMOND

If you're looking to grow and develop in a solid company, sign up below and explore the available opportunities on our portal: Drummond Job Portal

RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Strategic event planning: Develop and manage the annual event calendar aligned with organizational goals.
  2. Logistics coordination: Oversee transportation, accommodation, setup, and teardown processes.
  3. Communication planning: Collaborate with marketing teams to create promotional campaigns, including digital and physical materials.
  4. Budget management: Prepare and monitor event budgets, ensuring cost control and ROI optimization.
  5. On-site execution and supervision: Ensure smooth event execution by managing support teams and resolving real-time issues.
  6. Post-event analysis: Create post-event reports with success metrics and recommendations for improvements.
  7. Risk management: Identify potential issues before and during the event and develop contingency plans.
  8. Legal compliance: Ensure all aspects of the event comply with local regulations (permits, safety measures, etc.).

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

MUST HAVE:

  1. Effective communication: Ability to articulate ideas and provide clear instructions to teams and stakeholders.
  2. Organization and attention to detail: Critical for managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
  3. Negotiation skills: Essential for dealing with suppliers and strategic partners.
  4. Extensive experience: At least 3 years of experience in planning and executing medium/large-scale events.
  5. Advanced or fluent English: as reports may involve communication with external parties (auditors, investors, tax authorities).

NICE TO HAVE:

  1. Advanced soft skills: Ability to work under pressure, resolve issues quickly, and handle last-minute demands.
  2. Market trend awareness: Experience with hybrid events (in-person and virtual).
  3. Creativity and innovation: Proven ability to develop unique event concepts.
  4. Knowledge in additional languages: Especially Spanish or other languages for international events.

DRUMMOND CULTURE

At Drummond, we promote a dynamic culture that values collaboration and partnership among employees, creating a stimulating environment where everyone can contribute and grow together. We offer the opportunity to work in the international market, which broadens perspectives and strengthens our team’s global vision. Additionally, our commitment to continuous development is evident through our training and skill-building initiatives, ensuring each team member has access to opportunities that enhance their abilities and boost their careers.

DIVERSITY:

We have an increasingly diverse and inclusive environment. We value diversity and are committed to promoting inclusion and equity in our teams. As part of our strategy for diversity and inclusion, we aim for societal representation in our workforce.

BENEFITS

  1. Health Plan - No cost to the employee
  2. Psychological Support – Online platform
  3. Life Insurance - No cost to the employee
  4. English and Education Subsidy - because we invest in those who make things happen!
  5. TotalPass Partnership - because a healthy body and mind matter!
  6. Quarterly Bonus - when eligible, according to internal policy (After 6 full months in the company)
  7. Birthday Day Off (For you to enjoy with those who matter to you!)
  8. Extended Leave: Maternity (6 months leave) and Paternity (20 days leave) + $350 in case of the birth or adoption of a child
  9. Corporate University - to enhance your knowledge and strengthen your skills!
